issues.on_page: LB 840 loan proceeds 61,372 (LB 840 Fund, printed inside Total revenues; listed under General revenues on p3)
issues.issue: Assumed to be borrowing. In an LB 840 fund, 'loan proceeds' may be repayments of loans the village made to businesses, which would be revenue rather than debt proceeds. The report doesn't say which.
'Transportation' (also detail[32] 1,031, detail[50] 184, detail[55] 351) could be fuel/vehicle cost rather than travel
enterprise capital outlay classed as utilities; capital outlay is also defensible
